title: Budgeting & Contract Milestones: Forecast-to-Revenue Playbook
author: Marcus Lee
body:
Overview

Purpose: This playbook defines the end-to-end process for aligning budgeting and forecasts with customer contract milestone billing and revenue recognition rules. It is intended for Finance (Revenue Accounting, FP&A), Sales Ops, Legal, and Procurement partners who manage contracts that include milestone-based billing, partial deliveries, or multi-period performance obligations.

Scope: Applies to all customer contracts where billing or revenue recognition is driven by discrete milestones, acceptance events, or usage thresholds. Excludes standard monthly subscription-only contracts covered by the Subscription Billing policy.

Key principles

- Single source of truth: Contract milestone definitions in Contract Repository (CR-ID) are authoritative for billing triggers and recognition schedules.
- Forecast fidelity: FP&A forecasts must reflect the expected timing and recognition method for each milestone (deferred, over time, or at point-in-time).
- Change discipline: Any change to milestone timing, acceptance criteria, or billing triggers must follow the change-management steps below and be reflected in both the FP&A forecast and RevRec schedules within 48 business hours.

Definitions

- Milestone: A contract-defined deliverable or event that triggers billing or a portion of revenue recognition (e.g., delivery, acceptance, onboarding completion).
- Billing trigger: The event that authorizes invoicing (often tied to milestone completion or customer acceptance).
- Performance obligation (POB): The promised good/service to be delivered; revenue recognition method is determined per POB.

Who owns what (responsibilities)

- Sales / Account Executive: Ensure contract milestone definitions and acceptance criteria are clearly captured at signing. Provide amendments via Sales Ops.
- Legal: Review milestone language for enforceability and clarity; advise on acceptance language.
- Sales Ops: Record contract metadata into Contract Repository and flag non-standard billing or recognition clauses.
- RevRec / Revenue Accounting (Finance): Maintain journal schedules, deferred revenue buckets, and recognition rules. Final sign-off on recognition treatment.
- FP&A: Incorporate milestone timing and recognition method into revenue forecast and monthly re-forecast.
- Procurement (if vendor-managed deliverables): Coordinate acceptance confirmation and provide evidence for recognition.

Process: From contract to forecast (high level)

1) Contract intake and tagging (Sales Ops)
   - At contract signature, Sales Ops creates/updates the CR-ID record and tags each milestone with: milestone_id, acceptance_criteria, billing_trigger, billable_amount, recognition_rule (e.g., immediate, ratable over N months), and expected_date.
   - Non-standard clauses (e.g., contingent billing, customer escrow, delivery-dependent refunds) must include Legal sign-off.

2) Initial FP&A mapping (FP&A)
   - FP&A maps milestones to forecast lines: recognized revenue (by period), deferred revenue schedule, and cash collection forecast.
   - Add notes: probability adjustments (if milestone is contingent) with rationale and link to contract clause.

3) Invoice & recognition execution (RevRec)
   - When billing trigger occurs, Sales Ops or Billing team issues invoice using billing system and tags invoice with milestone_id and CR-ID.
   - RevRec posts invoice to AR and creates/adjusts deferred revenue schedule if recognition is over time.

4) Monthly alignment cadence
   - FP&A and RevRec run a joint monthly reconciliation: compare milestone expectations vs. activity, adjust forecasts, and publish delta analysis to Leadership.

Detailed procedures

A) Contract tagging checklist (Sales Ops)
   - Confirm presence of: milestone acceptance definition, billing trigger, net amount or price schedule, remedies/credits for failure to accept, and termination/force majeure clauses affecting timing.
   - Enter fields to Contract Repository: contract_id, customer_id, milestone_id, expected_date, bill_amount, recognition_method, supporting_doc_link.

B) Billing trigger execution (Billing team)
   1. Verify milestone completion evidence (QA report, customer acceptance email, deployment logs).
   2. Log acceptance evidence to CR-ID and attach to invoice.
   3. Create invoice using billing CLI or UI and include metadata flags: --contract CR-1234 --milestone M-2 --billing-trigger "acceptance" --amount 50000 --invoice-date 2026-03-01.

   Example CLI (billing):
   redwood-billing create-invoice --contract CR-1234 --milestone M-2 --amount 50000 --date 2026-03-01 --evidence-url https://cr.company/contrib/CR-1234/evidence.pdf

C) RevRec posting rules (Revenue Accounting)
   - Point-in-time recognition: Record revenue on invoice date when POB satisfied on that date.
   - Over-time (ratable) recognition: Create deferred revenue schedule and amortize monthly (or as specified).
   - Contingent milestones: Do not recognize until contingency resolved; reflect in FP&A as probability-weighted pipeline.

   Standard journal entries (examples):
   1) Invoice with ratable recognition (on invoice date):
      Dr Accounts Receivable 50,000
      Cr Deferred Revenue (liability) 50,000

   2) Monthly recognition (first of month):
      Dr Deferred Revenue 16,667
      Cr Revenue 16,667
      (Assumes 3-month ratable schedule)

D) Forecast update and re-forecast rules (FP&A)
   - Weekly rolling forecast updates for the next 90 days; monthly comprehensive re-forecast for quarters.
   - Trigger an immediate forecast update if any of the following occur: milestone slips > 14 calendar days, customer rejects acceptance, scope change > 10% of milestone value.
   - When a milestone is delayed, FP&A applies an adjustment entry in the forecast with one-line narrative: "CR-1234 M-2 delayed due to acceptance testing — impact: -$50k recognized revenue, move -$50k from Q2 to Q3 forecast."

E) Contingency handling and credits
   - If contract includes customer credits or rollback clauses tied to failed acceptance, Sales Ops must: 1) record the credit template in CR-ID, 2) notify Billing and RevRec, 3) create a credit memo referencing the original invoice.
   - Accounting treatment: book credit memo to reduce AR and adjust deferred revenue if previously recognized. Work with RevRec for retrospective adjustments if recognition timing spans prior periods.

Tables & quick reference

Milestone to Forecast mapping (example):
| Milestone ID | Billing Trigger | Bill Amount | Recognition Method | Forecast treatment |
|--------------|-----------------|-------------|--------------------|-------------------|
| M-1          | Delivery        | $75,000     | Ratable over 3 mo  | Move $25k to recognized rev/mo for contracted months |
| M-2          | Acceptance      | $50,000     | Point-in-time       | Recognize in month of acceptance; include in cash forecast same month |
| M-3          | Usage threshold | $10,000     | Contingent          | Probability-weighted in forecast until threshold met |

Escalation & exception workflows

- Minor timing variance (<= 14 days): FP&A notes in rolling forecast; no formal escalation.
- Material slip (> 14 days or > $100k impact): Sales Ops files JIRA ticket to "REV-FORECAST" board and notifies RevRec and Sales leadership within 48 hours.
- Disputed acceptance: Escalate to Legal within 24 hours; place invoice on hold if dispute > 7 days and potential credit > 20% of invoice amount.

Communication and reporting

- Monthly Revenue Alignment Pack (owner: RevRec): Includes: planned vs actual milestone completions, deferred revenue roll-forward, forecast delta table, and open disputed invoices. Delivery: 3rd business day of month.
- Quarterly Executive Forecast Review (owner: FP&A): Narrative on material changes in milestone timing, probability assumptions, and any accounting policy judgment calls.

Controls and audit evidence

- Required evidence for recognition: signed acceptance, deployment logs, support ticket closure, or customer confirmation email. Upload evidence to CR-ID within 72 hours of the billing trigger.
- Segregation of duties: Billing cannot modify recognition method; RevRec approves recognition posting.
- Audit trail: All invoice and recognition metadata must be retained in the Contract Repository and GL for at least 7 years.

Operational examples (short)

1) Use case: Beta delivery billed $60k, ratable over 4 months
   - Invoice: create-invoice CR-345 --milestone M-BETA --amount 60000 --date 2026-05-05
   - Journal: Dr AR 60,000 / Cr Deferred Revenue 60,000
   - Monthly recognition: 15,000 per month for 4 months (Dr Deferred Revenue / Cr Revenue)

2) Use case: Acceptance contingent on third-party cert. Cert delayed 6 weeks
   - FP&A: move $40k expected recognition out 6 weeks, notify Sales Ops and Legal
   - Sales Ops: log contingency status and attach vendor cert correspondence
   - RevRec: hold recognition until acceptance evidence posted

Implementation notes and tooling

- Contract Repository (CR) fields required: contract_id, customer_id, milestone_id, expected_date, signed_date, bill_amount, recognition_method, evidence_link, legal_signoff.
- Billing CLI/UI must support metadata flags for contract and milestone IDs; invoices without metadata will be rejected at AR staging.
- FP&A forecasting model templates (spreadsheet and BI layer) will include flag columns for "probability" and "deferred_bucket_id" to allow roll-ups by recognition timing.

Appendix: common recognition scenarios and sample journal codes

- Code table: REV: 4000, DEFERRED_REV_LIAB: 2100, AR: 1100, CREDIT_MEMO: 1200

- Sample retrospective adjustment (when recognition criteria found to be unmet after posting):
   1) Reverse previously recognized revenue: Dr Revenue 20,000 / Cr Deferred Revenue 20,000 (if within same fiscal period) or post adjustment with commentary and CFO approval if cross-period.

- Evidence naming convention: CR-<contract_id>_M-<milestone_id>_<yyyy-mm-dd>_<type>.pdf

Questions & next steps

- Action item: Sales Ops to validate that all active milestone contracts have CR-ID and required fields populated by 2026-04-20.
- Action item: RevRec and FP&A to publish the first "Revenue Alignment Pack" for March activity by 2026-04-05.

Contact owners for clarifications: Marcus Lee (Revenue Accounting), Aisha Patel (FP&A), Liam Chen (Sales Ops).
